add.text: The transform maps a signal to the frequency domain. Starting from the definition we apply it to the input and divide by the transform of the output, which gives the transfer function.

ielts.text: I agree to a large extent. Cities that invest in cycling routes see less traffic, cleaner air and healthier residents, although some trips still need a car.

holistic.text: Aliasing happens when a signal is sampled below twice its highest frequency, as with a wagon wheel on film.
